products.title: YP3 Foam Aircraft
products.description:
Description

Name: Remote Control Aircraft

Color: Red/Blue

Flight time: about 10 minutes

Charging time: about 60min

Remote control distance: 80m

Body battery: 3.7v-1800mA/H Lithium-Ion Rechargeable Battery

Transmitter battery: 3*AAA battery (not included)

Quadcopter Size: 18*25.5*5.7cm

Color Box Size: 32.5*7*20.5cm

Motor: 4

Remote control function: One-key takeoff/ One-key landing/ Ascend/ Descend/ Turn left and right/ Forward/ Backward/ Fly left/ Fly right/ Roll/ Headless mode/ Fast and slow gear

Features:

Durable and Safe Design: Constructed from lightweight foam material, ensuring durability. The propellers are enclosed by a protective guard for safety, reducing the risk of injury and protecting the drone from damage.

Exciting Movement Capabilities: This kid-friendly drone inches and offers a variety of stunt flying options including 4 turbofan motor,360° flip, headless mode, one click return, emergency stop and basic movements like forward, backward, and side-to-side flight. An ideal gift for birthdays, Christmas, or holidays.

User-Friendly Operation: Features One Key Taking-off/Landing and an one key surround and hover function for easy takeoff and stable hovering. Includes a Headless Mode for easier control, regardless of the drone's orientation, and EPP drop resistant material making it suitable for kids, beginners, and hobbyists.

Packing List

1 * Quadcopter

1* Transmitter

1* Lipo Battery

1* USB Charging Cable

1* Instruction
